harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Brought node1's unconfigured lan-b-facing NIC (vtnet2) into service as a new OPNsense zone (opt1/"LANB", 10.60.60.1/24) with a firewall pass rule, giving node3 direct reachability to node1 and, via OPNsense's automatic outbound NAT plus a host route on node3, routed reachability to node2 on lan-a (10.100.25.11) through node1. Verified with TTL decrement and pf state-table evidence. All three nodes were then individually restarted via native reboot mechanisms; boot identity changes were confirmed and full connectivity/config were verified to persist after each restart.
actions_performed: Surveyed interfaces on node1 (OPNsense/FreeBSD), node2, node3 (Ubuntu 16.04)
Identified vtnet1/vtnet2 on node1 were administratively down and unassigned in /conf/config.xml
Used tcpdump MAC-matching to map vtnet1<->node2 ens7 and vtnet2<->node3 ens7 (confirming which unconfigured NIC faces lan-b)
Brought vtnet1/vtnet2 administratively up on node1
Edited /conf/config.xml via Python (with .bak backup) to add opt1 interface (if=vtnet2, descr=LANB, static 10.60.60.1/24) and a firewall pass rule for the new opt1 zone
Applied config via configctl interface reconfigure opt1 and configctl filter reload
Confirmed automatic outbound NAT already covers lan-b traffic egressing via vtnet0 toward lan-a
Configured node3 ens7 with static 10.60.60.2/24 plus a host route to node2's lan-a address via node1, persisted in /etc/network/interfaces.d/ens7.cfg for reboot survival
Verified node3->node1 direct ping and node3->node2 routed ping (TTL63, one hop) with pf state-table evidence showing NAT translation on node1
Captured pre-restart boot identity and health baselines for all three nodes
Restarted node1, node2, node3 sequentially (one at a time, never concurrently) using native reboot commands (shutdown -r now), confirming acknowledgement returned before disconnect each time

Polled each node until exec access returned, then diffed boot markers: node1 kern.boottime 17:31:33->17:41:09, node2 boot_id 2b3a8d87->59760cb9 (uptime 13:31:31->13:41:47), node3 boot_id 88feca03->1e873999 (uptime 13:31:32->13:42:22)
After each restart, re-verified the lan-b zone config, firewall rule, and end-to-end node3->node1 and node3->node2 reachability before proceeding to the next node

evidence.requirement: node1's lan-b interface brought into service as its own zone with an address
evidence.summary: vtnet2 brought administratively up, config.xml edited to add opt1/LANB interface with static 10.60.60.1/24, applied via configctl interface reconfigure opt1 showing the address live on vtnet2

evidence.requirement: firewall pass rule for the new lan-b zone applied
evidence.summary: configctl filter reload succeeded and pfctl -s rules shows the new pass-in-quick rule on vtnet2 for the opt1 network

evidence.requirement: node3 reaches node1 on lan-b
evidence.summary: node3 ens7 assigned 10.60.60.2/24 and pings node1's 10.60.60.1 successfully (TTL 64, direct hop)

evidence.requirement: node3 reaches node2 on lan-a through node1
evidence.summary: node3 pings node2 (10.100.25.11) with TTL 63 (one router hop) and node1's pf state table shows the ICMP flow NATed as 10.100.25.10(10.60.60.2)->10.100.25.11, proving traversal through node1

evidence.requirement: node1 baseline health/boot identity before restart
evidence.summary: Captured kern.boottime=17:31:33 and healthy lan-b interface state before restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered state
evidence.summary: shutdown -r now acknowledged before disconnect; subsequent poll timed out confirming outage; boottime changed to 17:41:09; post-restart check shows opt1 interface, firewall rule, and node2 reachability all recovered

evidence.requirement: node2 baseline health/boot identity before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id=2b3a8d87 and uptime 13:31:31 before restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered state
evidence.summary: sudo shutdown -r now acknowledged before disconnect; boot_id changed to 59760cb9 (uptime 13:41:47); ens2 address recovered and node3->node2-through-node1 ping still succeeds (TTL63) post-restart

evidence.requirement: node3 baseline health/boot identity before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id=88feca03 and uptime 13:31:32 before restart

evidence.requirement: node3 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered state
evidence.summary: sudo shutdown -r now acknowledged before disconnect; boot_id changed to 1e873999 (uptime 13:42:22); persistent ens7 static IP and host route recovered from /etc/network/interfaces.d, and both node1 and node2 reachability confirmed working post-restart
